title: Each work order is closed on its own
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 2, for internal customer A, in status Complete.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work orders list.
  2. Select work order 1 and work order 2 with their checkboxes.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list opens.

Step 2:

  • The list's bulk actions offer no way to close both at once.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “Closing several work orders at once. Each is closed on its own with its own posting date (S3-R2); a shop that parked Complete work orders closes them one by one.”
